question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is: **bilateral**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bilateral"** refers to something involving two sides, parties, or countries. (द्विपक्षीय)

 
 
• **Example: **The two countries signed a bilateral agreement to enhance trade relations.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that she conveyed her optimism that this visit would revitalise bilateral ties between Italy and India.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word should be **'bilateral'**, as it fits the context of the statement.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **bilateral**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Corporeal** (शारीरिक): Something that is tangible or physical.

 
 
• **Example:** The ghost was said to have no corporeal form.
 
 
 
• **Solitary** (एकाकी): Existing alone; without companions.
 
 
• **Example:** He lived a solitary life in the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Exclusive** (विशिष्ट): Restricted to a particular group or individual.
 
 
• **Example:** The club has exclusive membership criteria.
